name: Authentication bypass
signals: protected route reachable without normal auth
server API callable without the required role
role or account state changes unexpectedly
front-end guard relies only on localStorage or hidden UI
safe_tests: compare anonymous and approved test-account access
test one auth path at a time
treat front-end route access as a candidate until the backend API is tested
use only approved test identities for role comparisons
never guess real credentials or brute force
confirm: reproducible with a test account or anonymous state
a protected action or data view is actually reached
